context: Checks the agent avoids the Lambda Errors = 0 trap and captures the alarm detail page after verifying the graphed metric.

checklist.name: States the alarm is not a false positive
checklist.description: Response does not accept that Errors = 0 means the alarm is wrong

checklist.name: Explains native Errors metric semantics
checklist.description: Says AWS/Lambda Errors counts invocation-level failures

checklist.name: Explains Logs metric filter cause
checklist.description: Says an alarm driven by a Logs metric filter can fire on ERROR-level log lines

checklist.name: Notes clean exit still alarms
checklist.description: Says the invocation can exit cleanly and the alarm still fires

checklist.name: Captures alarm detail page
checklist.description: Says to screenshot the alarm detail page as evidence

checklist.name: Does not screenshot raw metric graph
checklist.description: Does not choose the raw AWS/Lambda Errors graph as the evidence page

checklist.name: Navigates via Alarms list
checklist.description: Route goes CloudWatch, Alarms, All alarms

checklist.name: Searches by alarm name
checklist.description: Uses the alarm name to find the alarm and clicks it

checklist.name: Verifies graphed metric first
checklist.description: Checks which metric the alarm graphs before capturing

checklist.name: Uses alarm deep-link form if giving a URL
checklist.description: If a URL is given it follows https://{region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region={region}#alarmsV2:alarm/{alarm_name}
